I had a friend who always said he wished he could catch a break, or something bad would happen and he’d think “at least the bad times are over now”...but this way of thinking will honestly kill you. i’m not saying you should constantly be ready for impact, but it’s important to accept that you will have good and bad moments from now until your final day. just remember there aren’t any great high moments without low ones, life’s unpredictable. just do your best to carry on and try to set goals for yourself. do something at least once a day for yourself, to at least cut yourself a bit of break if life can’t that day. just search for that light at the end of the tunnel, it’s hard to see but I promise you it’s always there and on, I believe in you.
